title: AI production & pipelines
description: I build generative AI into agency and brand production: controllable pipelines, an e-commerce content factory, team training. Igor Sanin, 17 years in commercial video.
headline: I build AI into production — without chaos or slop
sub: I help agencies and brands make graphics and video with AI on time, on brand and without losing quality. 17 years in commercial video, my own production team, and an engineering approach instead of prompt guesswork.
productsIntro: Three ways to work together. Start with any of them — one usually leads to the next.

products.title: AI unit for agencies
products.for: Communications, advertising and event agencies that want to make part of their visuals in-house instead of outsourcing them.
bullets: review your current workflow and show where AI saves time and where it only adds rework;
build a pipeline for your tasks: models, node-based workflows, asset libraries, an LLM copilot for briefs and scripts;
write guidelines and acceptance criteria, so results don't depend on who's at the computer that day;
support the team through its first live projects.
products.gets: A team that produces tender visuals, animatics, storyboards and individual shots on its own — faster and with predictable quality.

products.title: E‑commerce content factory
products.for: Brands and retailers with large catalogues that need hundreds of product cards and visuals in one consistent style.
products.does: I build a pipeline around your catalogue: a virtual studio, digital models and environments, standards for light, angles and composition. From a single product photo the system produces everything a product card needs: images, short videos, descriptions, specs and marketplace tags.
products.gets: Complete product cards, not just pictures. Visuals accurately convey shape, material, texture and colour, and copy and tags are adapted to each marketplace's requirements. New products reach the catalogue in minutes, not after a shoot day.

products.title: Workshop or course for your team
products.for: Marketing and creative teams, agencies, in-house studios.
products.does: I teach the craft, not just the buttons: scriptwriting, directing, editing — and how to build AI into all of it. From a one-day intensive to a multi-month course, online or in person.
products.gets: A team that knows why every frame is there and can take AI generation to commercial quality.

steps.title: Intro call, 15 minutes
steps.text: No brief, no commitment: you describe the task, I tell you what AI can realistically solve.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: A short written plan: what we automate, what stays with people, how many hours it will take.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.text: We test the approach on one real task before changing the whole process.

steps.title: Rollout and support
steps.text: Pipeline, guidelines, team training; after that I'm on hand when needed.

billing: I work on an hourly basis and give an estimate in hours before we start, so the budget is clear upfront.
casesIntro: Some projects are under NDA, so no names here. I'm happy to walk you through details and private work on a call.

cases.title: Mockup factory for an apparel brand
cases.text: For a brand with a catalogue of thousands of items, I automated marketplace product cards: a virtual studio, a pool of 15 digital models, and standards for light, angles and composition. From one product photo the system generates a full set of on-model images in a single click, accurately reproducing fit, fabric density and print type.

cases.title: Brand animation framework
cases.text: For a large company, I developed an animation style and a character base built on real employees. In the same style I created a virtual workspace. With these assets we produced two videos for the HR department in the company's brand identity.

cases.title: AI shots for commercial production
cases.text: A large commercial project needed massive establishing shots of historical and sci-fi locations. Instead of weeks of CGI or a location shoot, I generated them in a few hours. Some shots were hybrid: actors filmed on green screen, integrated into AI environments.

cases.title: Runet Prize: an identity made entirely with AI
cases.text: In 2022 we created the full ceremony identity with neural networks — among the first in the industry, with a team of 14. In 2024 the ceremony was held at the Tretyakov Gallery, and for 15 nominations we created paintings in the style of classic Russian artists, finished with hand-animated brushwork.

cases.title: Corporate course for an agency
cases.text: For a major communications agency I ran a course on scriptwriting, dramaturgy, directing and editing: 3 months, 18 sessions, hybrid format. The team applied it to their own tasks during the course and now uses it in AI-integrated projects.

contactTitle: Got an AI challenge? Let's talk
contactText: No brief, no commitment. Drop me a line and we'll have a 15-minute call: you tell me about the task, I'll sketch a few ways to solve it with AI.
